title: Vee9 Icons
description: Warm file and folder icons in ember orange, amber and sand. The perfect companion to the Vee9 Custom Theme.

title: Vee9 Time Tracker
description: Track how long you work on each project: daily timer, total time, time per file and language, daily goals and streaks. Right in its own sidebar tab.

title: mistpine
description: A dark color theme of cool, misty grays over a deep blue-green night, with muted, earthy accents.

title: Function Folding (Ctrl+M+O)
description: Fold TypeScript function and method bodies only, using the Ctrl+M, Ctrl+O shortcut.

description: Dreamweaver-style visual editor for VS Code & Antigravity: click-to-edit any HTML page, full style inspector, live browser preview with auto-reload, image editor, link manager, advanced color studio, SEO/a11y audit and a guided tutorial. By Pawan Mall.

title: Vee9 TODO Board
description: All TODO, FIXME, BUG, HACK and NOTE comments of your project in one sidebar tab. Grouped by file or tag, live updated and highlighted in the editor.

title: claude: commit msg!

title: Retro Computing Themes
description: Eight color themes inspired by classic computers and DOS tools: C64, Amiga Workbench 1.3, Norton Commander, Turbo Pascal, Atari ST, Mac OS 9, Windows 3.1 and Windows XP – original palettes, tuned for readable code.

title: Vee9 Env Guard
description: Hides the values in your .env files so secrets never leak while screen sharing or streaming. Reveal per line, copy without showing, and get warned when .env isn't git-ignored.

title: Vee9 File Size
description: Shows the size, line count and gzip size of the current file in the status bar, warns about huge files and finds the largest files in your workspace.

title: Git File Hash
description: MD5 / SHA-1 / SHA-256 / SHA-384 / SHA-512 / CRC32 of a file at any commit, across its whole history, find the commit by hash, and copy a file's hash to the clipboard

description: Convert Renesas common project file to Cmake project
